detail.title: 霜纹长剑
detail.description:
剑身流转着如霜的纹路，
仿佛封存了北境的寒风。
它曾陪伴无数旅者穿越黑暗，迎向黎明。

notes: Main children are flat. art_ nodes are non-touchable GImages. Native dynamic controls stay separate.
